test_title: PYST 32: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 29th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

_ a d f b _ d f b a _ f b a d _
solution:
Given sequence: _ a d f b _ d f b a _ f b a d _

 
• a b f d → **a** a d f - b **b** d f - b a **f** f - b a d **d**
 
• b a d f → **b** a d f - b **a** d f - b a **d** f - b a d **f**
